title: Kit Changed Part-Way Through an Equipment Rental and Demo Hire: the Allowance Set Aside From a Finding
content:
A technician who hands a rider different kit has the returning item in hand and looks it over, and the more often that has happened on one agreement the more of the amount a later finding carries is set aside.

## The rule

Where the agreement shows the kit was changed for another model at least twice, and the rental account carries at least 4 dates the item now on the agreement was out, the twice changed set-aside share of the amount is set aside. The twice changed set-aside share is 30 per cent.

Where the agreement shows the kit was changed for another model once, and the rental account carries at least 4 dates the item now on the agreement was out, the once changed set-aside share is set aside instead. The once changed set-aside share is 15 per cent.

In any other case nothing is set aside under this heading.

## The two conditions in combination

| Changes of model shown on the agreement | Dates the account carries for the item now on the agreement | Share of the amount set aside |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 4 or more | 30 per cent |
| 2 or more | 3 or fewer | none under this heading |
| 1 | 4 or more | 15 per cent |
| 1 | 3 or fewer | none under this heading |
| none | any | none under this heading |

The day count of 4 is read on both sides in the same way: 4 dates meets it, 3 dates does not, and it is counted for the item now written on the agreement rather than for every item the rider has had on it.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical finding

Take an agreement of the Equipment Rental and Demo line on which the amount stands at 89.00 USD when this heading is reached.

- The agreement shows two changes of model and the account carries 6 dates for the item now on it: 30 per cent of 89.00 USD, that is 26.70 USD, is set aside.
- The agreement shows one change of model and the account carries 4 dates for the item now on it: 15 per cent of 89.00 USD, that is 13.35 USD, is set aside.
- The agreement shows two changes of model but the account carries only 2 dates for the item now on it: nothing is set aside under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**Counting the dates against the right item.** An agreement whose kit was changed will carry dates out against more than one item. What is counted here is the dates carried against the item that now stands on the agreement, being the one the finding was entered against.
